subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should memory-core’s durable memory source of truth move from Markdown files to a plugin-owned typed SQLite record model for the Memory MVP, and what migration/provenance/review contract must ship with it?
rationale: The request defines a persistent user-state contract and upgrade boundary that affects memory ownership, migrations, provenance, review/forget flows, and sibling Memory MVP issues; automation should not choose that product contract alone.

options.title: Approve SQLite MVP record model
options.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement the schema and migration boundary in memory-core.

options.title: Keep Markdown canonical for now
options.body: Narrow or close the schema request and continue treating SQLite as retrieval/index infrastructure around Markdown durable memory.

options.title: Defer until memory convergence
options.body: Keep this as design backlog until maintainers choose the recommended memory plugin path called out in VISION.md.

recommendation.title: Approve SQLite MVP record model
recommendation.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement the schema and migration boundary in memory-core.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across the memory-core flush/docs and memory-host-sdk storage surfaces this decision would replace or migrate.
